title: Colts snap losing streak, but Shane Steichen must stop making excuses for Daniel Jones
text: The Athletic's James Boyd and 107.5 The Fan's Caleb Zuver react to the Indianapolis Colts snapping their five-game losing streak against the Miami Dolphins. title: Week 10 Recap: Bengals, Vikings & 49ers impress, Texans fall flat, WTF injuries to Hutchinson & Maye
channel_name: The Athletic Football Show: A show about the NFL
text: Who got the biggest win of Week 10? That might've been the Minnesota Vikings, who went on the road and dominated the Packers in Kirk Cousins' first game back with the team. Who looked the most dangerous in Week 10? That might've been the San Francisco 49ers, who piled up 584 yards in a 46-40 win over the Dallas Cowboys. Who supplied the biggest bummer of Week 10? That was likely the Houston Texans, who we can now finally (probably) write off after their loss to the Cleveland Browns? What was the biggest downer of Week 10? It happened right away, as injuries to Drake Maye and Aidan Hutchinson clouded the Detroit Lions' 35-10 win over the New England Patriots. Robert Mays, Derrik Klassen and Dave Helman dig into all that, and more, on this episode of The Athletic Football Show.
